title: LabourFlow
desc: A product-focused landing page for LabourFlow, introducing its labour compliance platform, explaining its value to labour law consultants, and encouraging visitors to request launch updates.
objective: Introduce LabourFlow to labour law consultants, communicate the platform's value proposition, and provide a clear way for interested visitors to request launch updates.
overview: A product-focused landing website for LabourFlow, a platform designed for labour law consultants. The website explains the product concept, presents its compliance-focused capabilities, and guides interested visitors toward the launch-update signup.
features: Clear value proposition for labour law consultants
deliverable: A responsive marketing website that presents LabourFlow's product concept and capabilities and gives prospective users a clear path to request launch updates.

title: KDM Associates
desc: A professional services website built to present KDM Associates' offerings clearly, establish a consistent online presence, and help prospective customers make contact.
objective: Present KDM Associates' services and professional identity clearly while making it straightforward for prospective customers to understand the offering and get in touch.
overview: A business website developed for KDM Associates, a professional services firm. The website organises service information, presents a consistent brand experience, and provides clear contact and enquiry paths for prospective customers.
deliverable: A professional business website with structured service information, responsive page layouts, and contact options designed to help prospective customers connect with the business.

title: Deep Blogs
desc: A full-stack content platform for publishing, organising, and discovering articles, with content management functionality and a responsive reading experience.
objective: Create a structured publishing experience that allows content to be managed efficiently and helps readers browse, search, and discover articles.
overview: Deep Blogs is a full-stack content platform for publishing, organising, and presenting articles. The application combines a reader-facing content experience with administrative workflows for managing articles and organising content.
deliverable: A full-stack content platform with article publishing, content organisation, search, and administrative management functionality.

title: Quick Cart
desc: A full-stack e-commerce application covering product discovery, customer accounts, shopping cart management, checkout, and order administration.
objective: Build an online shopping experience that connects product discovery, customer account management, cart operations, checkout, and administrative workflows.
overview: Quick Cart is a full-stack e-commerce platform built around the main workflows of an online store. It brings together product browsing, customer accounts, cart management, checkout, order history, and administrative product and order management.
features: Product catalogue with search and filters
deliverable: A full-stack e-commerce application combining customer-facing shopping functionality with administrative product and order management.

title: Wanderlust
desc: A travel and property listing application for discovering properties, filtering listings, managing properties, and exploring booking-related workflows.
objective: Develop a travel and property listing experience that helps users discover properties, explore listing details, and move through booking-related workflows.
overview: Wanderlust is a full-stack travel and property listing platform focused on property discovery and booking-related workflows. It combines listing management, search and filtering, user accounts, booking functionality, image management, and property administration in a responsive web experience.
deliverable: A full-stack travel and property listing application with search, listing management, user functionality, and booking-related workflows.

title: iDiscuss
desc: A developer discussion platform combining topic-based questions, code sharing, user profiles, and real-time communication using Socket.io.
objective: Create a community experience where developers can participate in discussions, share questions and code, and communicate through real-time features.
overview: iDiscuss is a full-stack community platform designed for developer discussions and interactive communication. It combines topic-based discussion features with real-time updates to support a more interactive experience for participants.
deliverable: A community web application combining discussion workflows, user features, and real-time communication capabilities.
